om_host.title: OpenMetadata Host
om_host.description: Base URL of the OpenMetadata API

options.tooltip: The component appends `/api/v1`. Must be reachable from Keboola's static egress IPs, or via the SSH tunnel below.
In OpenMetadata: Settings → Bots → your bot → Generate new token. A dedicated bot with a long expiry is recommended over the shared ingestion-bot.

use_ssh_tunnel.title: Use SSH Tunnel
use_ssh_tunnel.description: Reach the OpenMetadata host through an SSH bastion

options.tooltip: Standard SSH port; change only if your bastion listens elsewhere.

service_name.title: Service Name (Optional)
service_name.description: Name of the OpenMetadata DatabaseService this catalog writes under (the root of every FQN)

options.tooltip: One DatabaseService per Keboola stack is recommended. Leave empty to auto-derive a stable name from the stack id (e.g. keboola-<stack>). Set it only to pin a specific service name, or when two stacks write into one OpenMetadata instance and need distinct services.
